label: Thinks a commit copies the whole folder
description: The learner thinks ignored files are included in every commit.

remediation.explanation: A commit records tracked files only.

label: Confuses init and clone
description: The learner thinks clone is how you create a new repository.

remediation.explanation: init creates a repository. clone copies an existing one.

label: Confuses status and log
description: The learner looks at history when they need working-tree state.

remediation.explanation: status shows current changes. log shows commits.

label: Confuses staged and unstaged diff
description: The learner uses --staged when they mean unstaged changes.

remediation.explanation: diff is unstaged. diff --staged is staged.

label: Creates a branch but does not switch
description: The learner expects git branch to move them.

remediation.explanation: git branch creates. git switch changes branch.

label: Thinks a branch is a full copy
description: The learner thinks branching duplicates the repository.

remediation.explanation: A branch is a pointer to a commit.

label: Thinks merges always create a commit

remediation.explanation: A fast-forward moves the pointer without a merge commit.

label: Misremembers merge syntax
description: The learner passes two branches to git merge.

remediation.explanation: Switch to the target branch, then merge the source branch.

label: Does not recognise conflict markers
description: The learner does not know the marker format.

label: Deletes the conflicted file
description: The learner removes the file instead of resolving the content.

remediation.explanation: Edit, remove the markers, stage, and commit.

label: Thinks origin is a branch
description: The learner confuses a remote name with a branch name.

remediation.explanation: origin is a remote. main is a branch.

label: Confuses push and pull
description: The learner thinks pull uploads or push downloads.

remediation.explanation: push uploads. pull fetches and integrates.

label: Thinks a pull request deploys
description: The learner conflates review with deployment.

remediation.explanation: A pull request asks for review and merge.

label: Thinks review is optional
description: The learner misses the review and checks step.

remediation.explanation: Review and checks happen before merge.

label: Thinks .gitignore deletes files
description: The learner expects ignored files to disappear from disk.

remediation.explanation: Ignore rules stop tracking. They do not delete.

label: Thinks .gitignore untracks existing files
description: The learner expects an already tracked file to become ignored.

remediation.explanation: Use git rm --cached for tracked files.

label: Uses reset --hard too freely
description: The learner discards work or rewrites shared history.

remediation.explanation: Prefer restore and revert. reset --hard discards changes.
